etymologies.etymologyHTML: From sex +‎ -y.

quote.citation: 1978, “Da Ya Think I’m Sexy?”, in Blondes Have More Fun, performed by Rod Stewart:
quote.text: If you want my body and you think I'm sexy / Come on sugar let me know

definitions.definition: (of a thing or concept) Intriguing, appealing, likely to excite interest.

quote.citation: 2013, Kathy Casey, D'Lish Deviled Eggs, page 67:
quote.text: Creamy cheese, tangy-sweet peppers, and a hit of heat tango in this sexy deviled-egg combo.

quote.citation: 2020, Katja Brokke, “Amsterdam has been collapsing for years. Now it's paying the price”, in CNN Travel:
quote.text: "The management of the quay walls and bridges has lagged behind in recent decades because it was not given the political priority it deserves and it is not a sexy topic," says Dijksma.

definitions.definition: (rare) Sexual; relating to or involving sex.

etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Latin sex (“six”) +‎ -y, intended as a pun.

definitions.definition: (mathematics) Used to describe prime numbers that differ from each other by six.
